title: 5.7 A 4.7GHz, 27.7dBm Pout, 37.8% PAE, 5.8° AM-PM Distortion Polar SCPA Using In-Cell Fast Slope-to-Phase Self-Calibration and Asymmetrical 4-to-1 Differential Power-Combining Transformer
problem: Digital power amplifiers (DPAs) for sub-6G and WiFi applications require high output power, high efficiency, and low linearity distortion to support complex modulation (high-order QAM). Conventional DPAs need additional digital pre-distortion (DPD) modules increasing area and power consumption. Voltage-mode switched-capacitor power amplifiers (SCPAs) improve linearity but suffer AM-PM (amplitude-to-phase) distortion at high frequencies due to transistor switching delays affecting waveform shape and phase response.
motivation: Wireless systems demand power amplifiers with minimal external DPD overhead, high linearity for wideband modulation, and integration into compact SoC designs.
method: Edge detectors in each unit cell identify switching delays, and a slope-to-phase tuner adjusts signal edges in real-time to cancel the resulting phase distortion. Since the self-calibration responds within one modulation period, it can handle signals across a wide frequency range. An asymmetrical 4-to-1 differential power-combining transformer balances impedance and efficiency, and this built-in calibration eliminates the need for separate digital pre-distortion.
key_novelty: Real-time in-cell slope-to-phase self-calibration corrects AM-PM distortion (phase shift changing with signal amplitude) in high-frequency switched-capacitor amplifiers without external digital pre-distortion, enabling direct support for complex modulation formats.
contributions: Output power: 27.7dBm at 4.7GHz with 37.8% PAE (high efficiency)
AM-PM distortion: 5.8° (low linearity error, suitable for complex modulation)
In-cell self-calibration eliminating need for external DPD module
Asymmetrical 4-to-1 differential combining transformer optimizing impedance matching and efficiency
primary_theme: Self-calibrating switched-capacitor power amplifier for high-linearity wireless TX
